confidence_contract: One genuine finite score per case/class in fixed source-global class order; original ProtST outputs learned-head BCE logits, no thresholded-label substitution. The disabled Qwen proposal explicitly defines omitted sparse numeric-map entries as zero before inference. Malformed/missing/truncated outputs do not become all-zero vectors.
auprc_micro_definition: Flatten every case/class pair, sort descending using torch.argsort; sum precision at positive ranks and divide by number of positives plus 1e-10. This is rank average precision.
f1_max_definition: Sort labels within each protein; update per-protein cumulative precision/recall at global descending score ranks. Mean precision uses proteins with at least one predicted term; mean recall uses all proteins (zero-target rows contribute zero). Return maximum harmonic mean over every rank position, epsilon 1e-10. Not a fixed 0.01 threshold grid.
tie_qualification: Source torch.argsort tie order and within-tie rank evaluation are retained. Sparse omitted zeros make this consequential; future scorer must pin CPU/Torch/thread/case/class ordering before responses. Author dependency/device ordering is unavailable, so exact tie-equivalence is unverified.
deepfri_original_metric_difference: DeepFRI utils._micro_aupr calls sklearn.average_precision_score(average=micro), which groups tied thresholds; it can differ from TorchDrug rank AP on tied scores. Do not merge these metric names or choose the better result.
output_score_ontology_propagation: No score propagation in audited ProtST/TorchDrug MultipleBinaryClassification.predict/evaluate. Use provided target matrix directly. Do not add max-child-to-parent prediction propagation silently.
